title: hugonia viscosa
intro: Hugonia viscosa, commonly known as Indian swamp-c cashew, is a plant species found in tropical regions of Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use in treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hugonia viscosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
